name: codex-update-header-still-ambiguous
description: The Codex hunk carries the header `@@ class Svc:`, but that line sits at the top and is ABOVE both candidate places, so it does not narrow anything: the context (`step()` then `done()`) still fits at lines 3-4 and 6-7. Codex applies it to the first match (appliedAt 3, truth only). Equal-size replacement, so the placements are comparable: the `done`/`finish` lines at 4 and 7 are Unknown(ambiguousMatch); the context lines, `def` lines and the class line are base under every placement. Stage `align`: the ops alone do not determine the final text. Contrast with codex-update-header-disambiguates, where the header sits between the twins.
